audience: online sellers and logistics teams who follow parcels across carriers with 17TRACK

useCases.title: List tracked parcels and their delivery status
useCases.text: The AI lists registered tracking numbers with carrier, status, last update and latest event. It filters by carrier, tracking state or package status, such as delivered.

useCases.title: Read the full history of a parcel
useCases.text: The AI gets the status, every carrier event with time and location, and the estimated delivery for up to 10 registered numbers.

useCases.title: Look up one number directly at the carrier
useCases.text: The AI checks one tracking number at the carrier without registering it. It uses 1 quota per call.

useCases.title: Start tracking new parcel numbers
useCases.text: The AI registers up to 10 tracking numbers per call. Each accepted number uses 1 quota, and you can check what is left first.

useCases.title: Fix a carrier, label a number or stop tracking
useCases.text: The AI assigns another carrier to numbers, sets your own tag on a number, stops tracking, or restarts tracking of a stopped number once.
